body.x: XAIMED Co., Ltd. (CEO Sang Min Park) participated in CES 2024, held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday, local time).

XAIMED is a leading company in AI medical devices that connect daily life, healthcare, AI, and people. XAIMED's "eXplainable AI (XAI)" technology addresses the black box issue of medical AI while providing customized solutions based on medical images, time-series biological data, and structured data.

XAIMED expanded its AI product range from AI for eye diseases and arterial sclerosis to urology, laparoscopy, endoscopy, and more. The company strives to connect AI and humans by providing eXplainable AI (XAI) solutions. These solutions aim to offer clearer evidence, allowing both doctors and patients to trust artificial intelligence in various medical fields.

At this year's CES, XAIMED unveiled the 'XAI Bio-Integrated Sensor Intelligent Solution,' which allows individuals to check and manage their health status in everyday life. This solution integrates fragmented body measurement devices such as electrocardiographs, thermometers, body composition analyzers, blood pressure monitors, and corneal saturation monitors. XAIMED has developed and incorporated a miniaturized module for skin fluorescence advanced glycation end products (AGE) sensor, a core technology for non-invasive measurement for diabetes prevention, management, and monitoring.

Thus, the XAI Bio-Integrated Sensor Intelligent Solution can simultaneously measure vital signs such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, skin temperature, body composition, and skin fluorescence advanced glycation end products (AGE) with just one test. XAIMED emphasized that they have enhanced the testing performance by applying their self-developed AI module and firmware to the product, allowing it to collect multiple biosignals simultaneously with low power consumption.

body.x: Additionally, utilizing fingerprint sensor information, the product provides a feature to identify users when multiple users use a single device. This feature addresses the test's user integrity, security, and identifiability, enabling reliable data collection in institutions and similar settings. Moreover, the company anticipates that this product can perform in real-time remote medical situations through cloud networks.

A representative from XAIMED stated, "Through CES 2024, as we explore opportunities to expand our domestic and international market presence, we received significant interest from local partners for collaboration in targeting the Japanese market, as well as investors from the United States and Europe." The representative expressed optimism: "With meaningful encounters and opportunities continuing at the exhibition, we anticipate the potential for creating actual contracts and achieving tangible outcomes in the future."

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), is held in Las Vegas every January, providing a comprehensive view of global technology industry trends. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been selecting the best innovative products, companies, and technologies and conducting ‘BEST OF CES’ and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA’ selections. Additionally, through ‘AVING LIVE,’ they provide live coverage of CES issues.

The CES 2024 Seoul Pavilion operated on the most historical scale since Seoul’s first participation in CES in 2020, with the largest exhibition area, number of participating companies, and supporter numbers. Seoul Metropolitan Government collaborated with 13 institutions to design The Seoul Pavilion, which is essential in Seoul’s endeavors to establish Seoul as a startup hub. Among the participating companies in the Seoul Pavilion, 17 received innovation awards, proving their capabilities. Collaborated institutions include Seoul Business Agency, Seoul Bio Hub, Seoul Campus Town, Yangjae Innovation Hub, Gwanak-gu, Yonsei University, Korea University, Chung-Ang University, Sogang University, Kookmin University, Hanyang University, and Kyunghee University, totaling 13. Seoul City and institutions and supporters participating in industry-academic cooperation are matched 1:1 with companies, with a maximum of 85 supporters participating.
